decisions.rationale: The median-of-three implementation clamps correctly for ordered bounds, and the committed test passes.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, violating the specification and failing the committed test.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit; the inclusive-boundary test fails.
The candidate inverts the required test assertion, so the committed suite fails even though is_package_ready(True) returns true.

strategy_update: Prioritized exact specification-to-diff comparison and direct execution of each committed test suite, independent of fixture labels and peer votes.
